title: Ghost dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ghost body -->
  <path d="M35 25 Q50 10 65 25 L65 75 Q60 68 57 75 Q54 68 50 75 Q46 68 43 75 Q40 68 35 75 Z" fill="#b8e8ff" stroke="#dff4ff" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- wavy bottom highlights -->
  <path d="M35 72 Q40 66 43 73 Q46 66 50 73 Q54 66 57 73 Q60 66 65 72" fill="none" stroke="#8ad4ff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="38" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#1a3a6b"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="38" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#1a3a6b"/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="36" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="36" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- happy mouth -->
  <path d="M44 50 Q50 58 56 50" fill="none" stroke="#1a3a6b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="47" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ffb8d0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="47" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ffb8d0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- left arm dancing up -->
  <path d="M35 45 Q22 30 15 18" fill="none" stroke="#b8e8ff" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="15" cy="18" r="4" fill="#b8e8ff"/>
  <!-- right arm dancing down/out -->
  <path d="M65 50 Q80 60 85 70" fill="none" stroke="#b8e8ff" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="70" r="4" fill="#b8e8ff"/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill="#ffe066">
    <ellipse cx="78" cy="22" rx="4" ry="3"/>
    <rect x="81" y="10" width="2" height="12" fill="#ffe066"/>
    <path d="M81 10 Q87 10 86 16" fill="none" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#ffb8d0">
    <ellipse cx="20" cy="60" rx="3.5" ry="2.5"/>
    <rect x="23" y="50" width="1.8" height="10" fill="#ffb8d0"/>
    <path d="M23 50 Q28 50 27 55" fill="none" stroke="#ffb8d0" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9">
    <path d="M12 40 L13 44 L17 45 L13 46 L12 50 L11 46 L7 45 L11 44 Z"/>
    <path d="M88 35 L89 38 L92 39 L89 40 L88 43 L87 40 L84 39 L87 38 Z"/>
  </g>
</svg>
